title: The ₹34 gap: who pays for India's oil shock?

statusKey.VERIFIED_PRIMARY: Checked against an official / primary document
statusKey.VERIFIED_SECONDARY: Checked against a reputable report quoting the original; original not directly accessible
statusKey.ESTIMATE: Third-party estimate; must be attributed on screen
statusKey.DERIVED: AVRON arithmetic from verified inputs; working shown

claims.claim: Delhi retail price of diesel was ₹95.20/litre and petrol ₹102.12/litre on 23 October 2026 (IOCL outlet).
claims.publisher: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (PPAC), Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
claims.passage: RSP of Diesel in Delhi as per IOCL outlet as on 23-October-2026, Rs. 95.20/ltr; RSP of Petrol ... Rs. 102.12/ltr
claims.narrationQualifier: Say 'in Delhi'. Prices differ by state because of VAT.

claims.claim: On 15 May 2026 petrol and diesel were raised by ₹3/litre, the first revision in over four years.
claims.publisher: All India Radio (News on AIR), Prasar Bharati
claims.passage: Petrol and diesel prices were raised by Rs 3 per litre each on May 15 ... the first fuel price revision in over four years.

claims.claim: Delhi diesel path in May 2026: ₹87.67 → ₹90.67 (15 May) → ₹91.58 (19 May) → ₹92.49 (23 May) → ₹95.20 (25 May). Four hikes in ten days.
claims.publisher: Procurement Resource; All India Radio; ETV Bharat
claims.passage: May 23: diesel +Rs 0.91; May 25: diesel +Rs 2.71 to Rs 95.20 (Delhi). Cumulative since 15 May: diesel +8.6%, petrol +7.8%. AIR: diesel 91.58 on 19 May.
claims.evidence: secondary, cross-checked across 3 outlets and reconciled arithmetically (see D1)

claims.claim: Total May 2026 diesel increase in Delhi = ₹7.53/litre (+8.6%).
claims.evidence: derived from C2, C3; endpoint confirmed by C1

claims.claim: Brent crude for December settlement rose 4% to settle at $113.17 a barrel on 22 October 2026 after a drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field (which killed two people; operations unaffected).
claims.passage: Brent for December settlement climbed 4% to settle at $113.17 a barrel ... A drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field killed two people but left operations unaffected.
claims.narrationQualifier: Say 'after attacks in Saudi Arabia'. Do NOT say production was hit (it wasn't).

claims.claim: Jefferies: crude freight rates are about eight times pre-conflict levels, now more than 25% of landed crude cost vs around 3% before.
claims.passage: freight rates are eight times pre-conflict levels, now more than 25% of landed crude costs, up from around 3%

claims.claim: Jefferies estimates oil marketing companies' marketing losses at ₹28/litre on petrol and ₹34/litre on diesel (15-day average pricing).
claims.passage: Petrol: ₹28 per litre; Diesel: ₹34 per litre (Jefferies estimates)
claims.evidence: secondary report of broker research; earlier Jefferies note (16 Oct) said ₹26/₹30
claims.narrationQualifier: Must be framed as an estimate ('may be losing', 'one brokerage estimates'). Never state as fact.

claims.claim: ICRA (Sept 2026): marketing margins about −₹8/litre petrol and −₹9/litre diesel; daily OMC loss about ₹530 crore; Indian basket $117.4/bbl on 21 Sept vs FY26 average ~$66.
claims.passage: negative Rs. 8/litre on petrol and Rs. 9/litre on diesel ... the daily loss to the OMCs is estimated at Rs. 530 crore
claims.narrationQualifier: Show date (September) next to the figure; different date and method from Jefferies.

claims.claim: Delhi diesel on 23 Oct 2026 (₹95.20) is the same as the level set on 25 May 2026.
claims.working: C1 (₹95.20 on 23 Oct) = C3 endpoint (₹95.20 on 25 May). ICRA (C7, Sept) cites 'unchanged domestic fuel prices'.
claims.evidence: comparison of two verified data points + ICRA statement
claims.narrationQualifier: Phrase as 'five months later, the same ₹95.20'. Do not claim zero intermediate changes.

excluded.reason: Single low-reliability source; Q2 FY27 BPCL results not confirmed on exchange filings at time of research.

excluded.claim: Excise duty cut of ₹10/litre in March 2026
excluded.reason: Only a calculator-style blog; no official notification found.
